{{Ship module infobox}}

The '''Meta Alloy Hull Reinforcement Package''' is an optional internal module built from human research into [[Meta-Alloys]]. The current Class 1E package adds '''72 hull integrity''' and applies '''3% caustic resistance''' to the ship's hull. It draws no power.<ref name="module-data">[https://raw.githubusercontent.com/EDCD/coriolis-data/d4efdee1808b45ae7c60b9b30223b670375e95a4/modules/internal/meta_alloy_hull_reinforcement_package.json EDCD Coriolis Data: Meta Alloy Hull Reinforcement Package records], commit pinned; accessed 16 September 2026.</ref>

Unlike a standard [[Hull Reinforcement Package]], it provides no kinetic, thermal, or explosive resistance. Its defining property is stock caustic protection rather than broad conventional-combat resistance.

| 1E || 72 || 2 t || 0 MW || 0% || 0% || 0% || 3% || 7,501 Cr

The caustic resistance applies to damage reaching the hull; it does not protect an exposed internal module as though that module had its own resistance. Multiple hull-resistance sources combine through the normal resistance calculation rather than by simply adding percentage points.

== Unlock and acquisition ==

The package requires a permanent unlock at a '''Human Technology Broker'''. The current recorded cost is:<ref name="broker">[https://inara.cz/elite/techbroker/ INARA: Technology Broker unlocks], accessed 16 September 2026.</ref>

* 16 [[Meta-Alloys]]
* 25 Focus Crystals
* 22 Aberrant Shield Pattern Analysis
* 20 Configurable Components
* 12 Reinforced Mounting Plates

After the unlock, additional 1E packages are purchased for credits where stocked; the unlock materials are not paid again for every ordinary copy. Technology Broker locations and outfitting stock are dynamic.

{{Field note|Current Technology Broker listings identify the 1E package. Older guides and equipment datasets may show larger or D-rated Meta Alloy Hull Reinforcement variants; confirm live availability before planning around one of those entries.}}

== Comparison with other hull packages ==

{| class="wikitable"
! Family
! Power draw
! Stock resistance profile
! Engineering
|-
| Standard Hull Reinforcement Package || None || Kinetic, thermal, and explosive || Supported
|-
| Meta Alloy Hull Reinforcement Package || None || Caustic || Not supported
|-
| [[Guardian Hull Reinforcement Package]] || Required || Thermal and caustic || Ordinary hull blueprints not supported
|}

The Meta Alloy package occupies an ordinary optional internal slot. Fitting it therefore trades away the raw integrity or utility that another module could provide. Its 3% caustic resistance affects the ship's full hull pool, while its own 72-point contribution is modest; the value of the package is consequently tied to the build and expected damage type rather than to its integrity figure alone.

The Guardian alternative offers 5% caustic resistance and more raw integrity in its smallest D-rated form, but it requires power and a separate Guardian Technology Broker unlock. Standard engineered packages normally provide more integrity and conventional resistances but do not supply caustic resistance.

== Engineering ==

Meta Alloy Hull Reinforcement Packages do not accept the ordinary Heavy Duty, Lightweight, Blast Resistant, Kinetic Resistant, or Thermal Resistant Hull Reinforcement blueprints. No Experimental Effects are available.
